description: Minimizing the total test \(n\mapsto3\mathbin{\dot-}n\) returns the input \(3\), where the test first has output zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartialRecursiveFunctions.least_input_example :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.minimize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.lift fun x => 3 - List.Vector.get x 0) List.Vector.nil =
    Part.some 3
